AdditionalIdentification.name: Additional Identification
AdditionalIdentification.definition: Additional identification of the key.|Usage|For derived unique key per transaction (DUKPT) keys, the key serial number (KSN) with the 21 bits of the transaction counter set to zero.

SecurityProfile.name: Security Profile
SecurityProfile.definition: Identification of the set of security elements to which this element belongs.

ItemNumber.name: Item Number
ItemNumber.definition: Hierarchical identification of a key inside all the key system. It is composed of all item numbers of the upper level components, separated by the '.' character, ended by the item number of the current component.

SequenceNumber.name: Sequence Number
SequenceNumber.definition: Sequence number of the cryptographic key.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of algorithm used by the cryptographic key.

ActivationDate.name: Activation Date
ActivationDate.definition: Date and time on which the key must be activated.

DeactivationDate.name: Deactivation Date
DeactivationDate.definition: Date and time on which the key must be deactivated.

ComponentWithAuthorisedAccess.name: Component With Authorised Access
ComponentWithAuthorisedAccess.definition: Identification of components which are allowed to access this cryptographic key.

ProtectedComponentWithAuthorisedAccess.name: Protected Component With Authorised Access
ProtectedComponentWithAuthorisedAccess.definition: Protection of Identification of components which are allowed to access this cryptographic key.

KeyCheckValue.name: Key Check Value
KeyCheckValue.definition: Value for checking a cryptographic key security parameter.

AdditionalManagementInformation.name: Additional Management Information
AdditionalManagementInformation.definition: Additional Information needed by the receiver to securely process the management of the security element.

DerivationAlgorithmIdentifier.name: Derivation Algorithm Identifier
DerivationAlgorithmIdentifier.definition: Identification of the derivation algorithm that must be used.

AlgorithmIdentifier.name: Algorithm Identifier
AlgorithmIdentifier.definition: Identification of the algorithm and mode that must be used.
